summary.executiveSummaryReference: The team clarified several technical-file points for the T761 software workstream. David challenged the justification behind probability ratings, and the team agreed the software list could remain in Excel with explanatory context. The group considered standards applicability, especially 81001-5-1 and ISO 27427, reviewed the approved alarm change and clinical feedback, and tracked remaining language, debug, electrical testing and version-traceability work. Cybersecurity discussion focused on documenting a proportionate USB and GUI-control approach without creating clinical usability risk.
